ink-black.$description: Ink Black — High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces.

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Page canvas, announcement bar, card surfaces, product label backgrounds, button fills — warm cream that makes the entire site feel like aged paper

dusty-rose.$description: Dusty Rose — Secondary surface band, subtle tonal shift between cream sections — barely-distinguishable warm blush that creates the only depth in an otherwise flat system

sofia-pro.$description: Only typeface in the system. Weight 800 at 120px with 0.83 line-height and -0.05em tracking for editorial display headlines — the face is pushed to extreme sizes to feel like magazine cover type. Weight 400 at 12-16px for body and utility labels, all-caps with 0.05em tracking for nav items. Weight 600 used sparingly for emphasis in product copy.
